meta.triageRationale: bugfix/small: one function and its caller, reuses the existing range-base resolver.

body.focus: A trivial standalone build's validate gate runs the test files touched across the build's range (from resolveStoryRangeBase, src/workflow/runners/build/range-base.ts:327, the same base the change log and typecheck use), falling back to the HEAD commit only when no range base resolves. trivialCheckPlan (src/daemon/steps/build-step/validation-checks.ts:323-338) and its caller (src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/validate.ts:348). Tests show a test committed earlier in the range is run when a later commit is HEAD, and the HEAD fallback still applies with no base. Implements ISSUE-91640defac1b5816.
body.summary: 08c023de: trivialCheckPlan(repoPath, base?) lists __tests__ files changed in base..HEAD when a base resolves, else the HEAD commit's; handleStandaloneValidate passes resolveStoryRangeBase. dcc39996 (code review round 1, MED): a listing git refuses now fails the tests check (noTests ok:false, "could not list the build's files: ...") instead of passing as "no tests"; build-step.test.ts's no-git trivial fixture assertion updated to expect that. 8a0516f9 is a --no-ff merge of upstream docs-only commits. Tests: validation-checks.test.ts, build-start.test.ts, build-step.test.ts; three falsifying mutations (caller passes no base, base ignored, error path ok:true) each fail a test. build-step + workflow + MCP suites: 2295 pass, the only other failure the pre-existing review-decision one.
